name: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS)
description: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS) is a large-scale, public-domain, read-speech corpus derived from LibriVox audiobooks (mostly Project Gutenberg texts), covering 8 languages with ~44.5K hours of English and ~6K hours across German, Dutch, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, and Polish. Audio was downsampled to 16 kHz, segmented into 10–20s utterances, pseudo-labeled with ASR and matched to book texts via TF-IDF and Smith-Waterman alignment, with post-processing for numbers, hyphens, and apostrophes; dev/test transcripts were human-verified and limited-supervision (10h/1h/6×10min) subsets are provided. Pre-built 3-gram/5-gram LMs and baseline ASR models are released alongside the dataset.
license: Public domain source content (LibriVox/Project Gutenberg); dataset released freely at OpenSLR (specific license text not explicitly stated)
inLanguage: English, German, Dutch, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, Polish
publisher: OpenSLR (dataset distribution site); paper authors from Facebook AI Research
citeAs: Pratap, Xu, Sriram, Synnaeve, Collobert. MLS: A Large-Scale Multilingual Dataset for Speech Research. arXiv:2012.03411, 2020.

rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollection: Audiobooks downloaded from LibriVox; audio downsampled to 16 kHz and segmented (10–20s) using acoustic models with ASG-based segmentation; pseudo labels generated via beam search with 4-gram LMs; source texts scraped/parsed from Gutenberg, Archive.org, CCEL, HathiTrust (English) and various multilingual domains with manual retrieval when needed; transcripts retrieved by TF-IDF document retrieval and Smith-Waterman alignment, filtered by WER ≤ 40%, with rules for numbers/hyphens/apostrophes; speakers/book metadata cleaned; speaker-gender inferred via SVM; dev/test human-verified.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataUseCases: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) training and benchmarking (monolingual and multilingual), language modeling, low-resource benchmarking (10h/1h/10min subsets), and Text-to-Speech (TTS) research (as an extension to LibriTTS).
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Audio is read-speech from public-domain audiobooks; speakers are LibriVox volunteers; no personal identifiers beyond speaker IDs are included; in-house models for segmentation trained on de-identified public videos; no sensitive categories described.
